title: Party leadership term row (Wikidata-sourced)
description: Logical contract for one row of datasets/data/entities/parties_leadership.csv. Term-shape register of party-leadership holdings (President/Chairperson per P488, General Secretary per P3975, plus whatever P39 position label the underlying Wikidata statement carries). Composite PK (party_id, valid_from); valid_to nullable (null = currently serving, never datetime.now per CLAUDE.md anti-pattern). source_id FKs into datasets/data/entities/source.csv per CLAUDE.md section 12. Sole writer: backend/yen_gov/sources/wikidata/party_leadership.py (PR-7 of TODO/20260613-party-deferred-followups-plan.md). PR-7 lays the schema rails only; PR-9 pins the SPARQL JSON snapshot at datasets/ephemeral/wikidata-party-leadership-<YYYY-MM-DD>.json and emits the actual data rows.

x-changelog.description: Initial party-leadership row schema. Per PR-7 of TODO/20260613-party-deferred-followups-plan.md (Max 2a/2d/2e verdicts). 7 columns: party_id (FK parties.csv) + role (P39 position label, free-text since Wikidata labels are open-ended) + person_name + person_wikidata_qid (nullable for hand-curated overrides) + valid_from (ISO date, required) + valid_to (ISO date, nullable = currently serving) + source_id (FK source.csv, nullable for hand-curated rows pending source ledger entry). Composite PK (party_id, valid_from).

party_id.description: FK into datasets/data/entities/parties.csv.party_id. yen-gov-issued party slug (parties.IN.BJP, parties.IN.AAP, ...). First member of the composite PK (party_id, valid_from).

role.description: Position label as published by Wikidata via P39 (or the P488/P3975 statement's qualifier). Free-text because Wikidata role labels are open-ended ('President', 'General Secretary', 'National Convenor', 'Working President', 'Acting President', ...). Citizen-readable; no enum closure.

person_name.description: Display name of the office-holder as published by Wikidata's ?chiefLabel (English). Verbatim transcription; no romanisation/normalisation here.

person_wikidata_qid.description: Wikidata Q-id of the holder (e.g. Q3104873 for J. P. Nadda). Nullable for hand-curated rows where the holder has no Wikidata entry (rare). PR-9 populates this from the SPARQL ?chief URI suffix.

valid_from.description: Term start as ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Truncated from the SPARQL P580 (start time) datetime payload by stripping at 'T'. Second (final) member of the composite PK (party_id, valid_from).

valid_to.description: Term end as ISO date YYYY-MM-DD. Null = currently serving (per CLAUDE.md: never datetime.now).

source_id.description: FK into datasets/data/entities/source.csv.source_id per CLAUDE.md section 12. Deterministic 'src-' + sha256(producer|title|vintage)[:12] derived by backend.yen_gov.canonical.citation.derive_source_id; never hand-typed. Nullable so hand-curated rows can land before the source ledger row exists (PR-9 will populate).
